checks.rule: V1 CSV header = raw schema (56 columns)
V4 every cell follows the section 7 operation sequence (op_seq 1..n)
V5 every row has its expected status / revert reason / return value (check_pass = 1)
V6 transaction type, gas limit, fee fields, chain id and protocol version as frozen
V7 fee accounting: one node record per transaction; pubdata_gas = pubdata_bytes x 84; receipt gasUsed reproduced exactly from computational_gas, pubdata_bytes and the fixed fee input
V8 deployed bytecode = compiled artifact (eth_getCode, versioned bytecode hash, size, one factory dependency)
V9 all 24 compiled contracts within the EraVM bytecode limit
V10 fresh chain per cell: nonces from 0, strictly increasing blocks, distinct transaction hashes
V11 anvil-zksync, zksolc and era-solc binaries = pins
V12 environment check passed (system contracts, protocol, fee-accounting probe)
V13 base system contracts = anvil-zksync 0.6.11 built-in protocol v29
